newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSAPANK CHIEF SEES LEASING MOVE BEYOND BALTIC.
newsitem.headline: HANSAPANK CHIEF SEES LEASING MOVE BEYOND BALTIC.

text.p: Hansapank, the biggest Baltic bank, is looking beyond the Baltic countries into neighbouring areas and this expansion is likely to be led by its leasing operation, chairman Hannes Tamjarv told Reuters.
"One of the strategies for the whole bank for 1997 is developing business contacts with Russian and Ukrainian businesses," Tamjarv told Reuters in a recent interview.
He said the group's leasing operation would be the part of the bank that moved first beyond Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania.
"They (the leasing team) will probably get outside the Baltics first," he said.
Tamjarv said that Hansapank was not in a rush to expand beyond the Baltic states and would use it leasing arm as a market information gathering service.
"We don't hurry, we don't rush. We do our research," He said.
